title: Cursor alternatives
summary: Cursor alternatives: candidate paths, switching costs and reasons to keep the original.

sections.heading: Match the reason to a candidate
paragraphs: Keep your current editor habits: inspect Copilot. Prefer command-driven tasks: trial Claude Code. Need provider configuration: inspect Cline. Treat Windsurf as a continuity question until the official redirect is resolved.

sections.heading: When to keep the original
paragraphs: Keep Cursor if your review loop works and the real problem is unclear task scope. Try better acceptance tests before replacing a tool.

sections.heading: Migration rehearsal
paragraphs: Create a copy of the project, remove production secrets, export data using a documented method and run the tests in the candidate workflow. Compare the work needed to restore service after a failed change. Keep the original until the rehearsal succeeds.

verdict: Changing an editor is worthwhile only when it resolves a specific constraint.
bestFor: Existing Cursor users with a specific workflow, budget or ownership constraint
notFor: Readers expecting a replacement to move code, data and infrastructure automatically
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
